question: What should I eat during my period?
answer: Focus on iron-rich foods (lean meats, leafy greens, lentils) to replace blood loss. Anti-inflammatory foods like fatty fish, ginger, and turmeric can help with cramps. Complex carbs like whole grains can help stabilize mood and energy.
